newsitem.title: FRANCE: Swissair ups Saturday Zurich-Tokyo MD-11 cargo rate.
newsitem.headline: Swissair ups Saturday Zurich-Tokyo MD-11 cargo rate.

text.p: Swissair said it planned to increase air cargo rates by six percent, on its scheduled McDonnell Douglas MD-11 passenger service, operating Saturdays between Zurich and Tokyo, with effect from October 1, 1996.

"There is very heavy demand for cargo capacity on this particular flight and we have taken the decision to apply peak pricing on it," Swissair's cargo pricing manager, Urs Voellmin, told Reuters by telephone from Zurich.
The MD-11 passenger version has a cargo capacity of around 17 tonnes.

Cargo rates on Swissair's four other weekly MD-11 passenger flights between Zurich and Tokyo would remain unchanged as would those on the Swiss carrier's Zurich-Osaka MD-11 passenger route, Voellmin said. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
